_comment: Cypht user-config seed: CardDAV (Radicale) + RSS feeds source + UI settings. Mail accounts live in seed-accounts.json. Read at runtime by seed-accounts.php inside the cypht container, mounted at /tmp/cypht-config/seed-config.json.

radicale._note: Radicale auth = IMAP-delegated to Maddy (aa-sui_radicale/src/templates/config.tpl:5-7), so the user's CardDAV password = their Maddy ME_PASSWORD (already in cypht/src/secrets.yaml). user_env=PRIMARY_EMAIL is a special token meaning 'use seed-accounts.json#primary.email'.

feeds._note: ntfy topic list lives in I_cloud-data/ntfy-api/src/topics.json (canonical, 18 topics). flake.nix copies it to dist/assets/ntfy-topics.json at build time, mounted into the container alongside this file. seed-accounts.php iterates topics and emits one feed per entry.

settings._note: User-facing UI preferences. Keys verified against modules/themes/modules.php, modules/sievefilters/modules.php, modules/smtp/modules.php, modules/contacts/modules.php in cypht-org/cypht. All keys end in _setting per Cypht convention.
